tools.name: zvec_grep_callees
tools.description: Outgoing call sites for a symbol. Shows callee definitions and call-site locations in the caller file. Accepts name, scope::name or scope.name; ::name selects top-level definitions. Queries matching more than 10 indexed definitions fail; narrow the scope or use globs. limit counts call sites per definition (default 20, maximum 50); a truncation notice marks omitted sites. Exact misses may return suggestions without call sites. Returns readable text with one-based line and byte-column numbers. Requires graph indexing enabled with zg --index --graph (add --rebuild for an existing index). Reads persisted resolved calls without refreshing; empty results do not prove absence.

GlobListInput.description: Public string/list globs plus the existing typed-rule extension.

root.description: Absolute workspace root visible to the daemon.

symbol.description: Symbol name or scope-qualified name, such as `Class::method` or `Class.method`; `::name` selects only top-level definitions.

globs.description: Ordered workspace-relative glob rules for definitions and suggestions; call-site files remain unrestricted.

insensitiveGlobs.description: Ordered case-insensitive glob rules, applied after globs, as in search.

limit.description: Maximum call sites per matching symbol; defaults to 20, capped at 50.

annotations.title: Outgoing call sites for a symbol
